newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 15.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 15.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
Hurricane Enrique was spotted 918 miles (1469 km) west of the island of Socorro, moving northwest at 14 knots (15 miles/27 km), with winds from 80 to 95 knots (88 miles/141 km to 105 miles/168 km).
The ministry said Enrique was not expected to affect Mexico's coastline. Ships were advised against sailing in the region.
Electric storms and strong winds were reported in Oaxaca, Chiapas, Michoacan and Guerrero. Strong rains and storms also in Yucatan and Quintana Roo.
